component.name: VoyagerSP
component.summary: Star Trek: Voyager — Elite Force, single player, on native Linux

description.p: VoyagerSP runs the single-player campaign of Star Trek: Voyager — Elite Force natively on Linux: the id Tech 3 engine with the original Raven game, client-game and UI modules, on a Vulkan renderer ported from Quake3e.

The retail game data is not included and cannot be downloaded here. An installation of the original game (retail CD or the GOG release) is required; VoyagerSP locates its BaseEF directory or is pointed at it with the VOYAGERSP_DATA environment variable.

ul.li: Vulkan renderer, widescreen and arbitrary resolutions
The original game modules, cutscenes and MP3 voice-over
Self-contained: no distribution packages needed beyond a Vulkan driver
